opening.argument: The video reviews the Citi Rewards+ and Rewards+ Student cards and explains a specific card term: even a small transaction earns at least 10 points. Its discussion of scripts and repeated payments is framed as a hypothetical risk, not a guaranteed way to profit. The speaker calls the approach “extremely dangerous” and says only that it “might work”; the suggested 11- or 20-cent gain is likewise presented as a possibility. That conditional treatment supports a review of an ordinary rewards feature, not a promise of an outcome. The referenced affiliate links and subscription prompt are ordinary channel engagement.
